utterances.label: silence
utterances.description: 200 ms of digital silence. Nothing should be heard, so no final and no turn.

utterances.label: tone
utterances.description: One 300 ms 440 Hz tone with one labelled endpoint: one answered turn.

utterances.label: thinking-pause
utterances.description: Two 260 ms tones split by a 1.2 s thinking pause. The default 1.8 s hold gathers both endpoints into one turn.
